description: Retrieve a single federal administrative-practice document by its doc_id (e.g. 'estv_ks_ks_nr_28', 'sem_weisungen_weisungen-aug-d', 'bsv_weisungen_6930_v20_de', 'seco_alv_avig_ale_de', 'un_uhri_3f3a9db7-5e9a-416f-ad28-8c8f97a8322c_en'). Returns the body text, title, date, issuing authority, and PDF URL. Long documents (circulars run to 140 pages) come in parts of 50,000 characters: when has_more is true, call again with offset=next_offset. Use search_practice first to discover the doc_id.

max_chars.description: Characters of body text per part (default 50,000, max 150,000).

offset.description: Character offset into the body text to start from (default 0); use next_offset from the previous part.

name: get_practice
title: Get administrative practice
